name: tasks: the scheduler opens empty; fake file access (no dialogs): two project files in, an output folder that keeps what is written
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.ensureKernel(); await m.actions.openSampleAsk('flange'); await sleep(1200); m.actions.updateSettings({ tasks: [] }, { quiet: true }); const text = JSON.stringify(m.project); window.__out = {}; window.__back = {}; const fileHandle = (name, body) => ({ kind: 'file', name, getFile: async () => new File([body], name), createWritable: async () => ({ write: async (b) => { window.__back[name] = typeof b === 'string' ? b : new TextDecoder().decode(b instanceof Blob ? new Uint8Array(await b.arrayBuffer()) : b); }, close: async () => {} }) }); window.__fileHandle = fileHandle; window.__pick = [fileHandle('alpha.mymech', text), fileHandle('beta.mymech', text)]; window.showOpenFilePicker = async () => window.__pick; window.showDirectoryPicker = async () => ({ kind: 'directory', name: 'out', getFileHandle: async (name) => ({ createWritable: async () => ({ write: async (b) => { window.__out[name] = b instanceof Blob ? new Uint8Array(await b.arrayBuffer()) : b; }, close: async () => {} }) }) }); m.run('taskScheduler'); await sleep(300); const pm = document.querySelector('.left-pm-body'); return JSON.stringify({ mode: m.state.editing?.mode, empty: /No tasks yet|작업이 없습니다/.test(pm.textContent), kinds: pm.querySelectorAll('[data-pm^="task.new:"]').length }); })()

name: tasks: a property task on the open document sets the description everywhere, logged, one undo step
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); q('[data-pm="task.new:properties"]').click(); await sleep(200); q('[data-pm-set="tkSrc"][data-value="current"]').click(); await sleep(150); q('[data-pm-set="tkRowMode:0"][data-value="set"]').click(); await sleep(150); const v = q('[data-pm-field="tkRowValue:0"]'); v.value = 'Batch {project}'; v.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await sleep(150); q('[data-pm="task.run"]').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 50 && !m.tasks.tasks()[0]?.lastRun; i++) await sleep(100); await sleep(200); const tk = m.tasks.tasks()[0]; const desc = m.project.parts.map((p) => p.description); const log = [...document.querySelectorAll('.task-log li')].map((li) => li.textContent).join(' | '); await m.actions.undo(); await sleep(300); const undone = m.project.parts.map((p) => p.description); return JSON.stringify({ status: tk.lastStatus, set: desc.every((d) => /^Batch /.test(d)), logged: /description|설명/.test(log), undone: undone.every((d) => !/^Batch /.test(d)) }); })()

name: tasks: an export task on two picked files writes STEP and STL of every part into the output folder
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); q('[data-pm="task.new:export"]').click(); await sleep(200); q('[data-pm="task.addFiles"]').click(); await sleep(300); q('[data-pm="task.browseOut"]').click(); await sleep(300); q('[data-pm-toggle="tkFmt:stl"]').click(); await sleep(200); const id = m.state.editing.sel; window.__out = {}; q('[data-pm="task.run"]').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 300 && !m.tasks.task(id)?.lastRun; i++) await sleep(200); const tk = m.tasks.task(id); const names = Object.keys(window.__out).sort(); const parts = m.project.parts.length; const step = names.find((n) => n.endsWith('.step')); window.__step = step ? window.__out[step] : null; const head = step ? new TextDecoder().decode(window.__out[step].slice(0, 20)) : ''; return JSON.stringify({ status: tk.lastStatus, files: tk.source.paths, count: names.length === 2 * 2 * parts, alpha: names.some((n) => /^alpha - .+\.step$/.test(n)), stl: names.some((n) => /^beta - .+\.stl$/.test(n)), iso: head.startsWith('ISO-10303-21') }); })()

name: tasks: the open document is untouched by the background run (same parts, same active document, no undo step)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; return JSON.stringify({ active: m.project.active?.kind, canUndo: m.state.doc.history.canUndo, parts: m.project.parts.length > 0, view: (m.viewport.bodies?.size ?? 1) > 0 }); })()

name: tasks: an import task turns that STEP file into a MyMechanics project with an imported part
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); window.__pick = [window.__fileHandle('valve body.step', window.__step)]; q('[data-pm="task.new:import"]').click(); await sleep(200); q('[data-pm="task.addFiles"]').click(); await sleep(300); q('[data-pm="task.browseOut"]').click(); await sleep(300); const id = m.state.editing.sel; window.__out = {}; q('[data-pm="task.run"]').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 300 && !m.tasks.task(id)?.lastRun; i++) await sleep(200); const tk = m.tasks.task(id); const out = window.__out['valve body.mymech']; const p = out ? JSON.parse(typeof out === 'string' ? out : new TextDecoder().decode(out)) : null; return JSON.stringify({ status: tk.lastStatus, name: p?.name, imported: p?.parts?.[0]?.features?.[0]?.type, brep: (p?.parts?.[0]?.features?.[0]?.brep ?? '').length > 1000 }); })()

name: tasks: a design check task writes a report per file and a summary CSV
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const text = JSON.stringify(m.project); window.__pick = [window.__fileHandle('alpha.mymech', text), window.__fileHandle('beta.mymech', text)]; q('[data-pm="task.new:designCheck"]').click(); await sleep(200); q('[data-pm="task.addFiles"]').click(); await sleep(300); q('[data-pm="task.browseOut"]').click(); await sleep(300); const id = m.state.editing.sel; window.__out = {}; q('[data-pm="task.run"]').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 300 && !m.tasks.task(id)?.lastRun; i++) await sleep(200); const names = Object.keys(window.__out).sort(); const csvName = names.find((n) => n.endsWith('.csv')); const csv = csvName ? (typeof window.__out[csvName] === 'string' ? window.__out[csvName] : new TextDecoder().decode(window.__out[csvName])) : ''; return JSON.stringify({ reports: names.filter((n) => n.endsWith('.html')).length, csv: /^File,Errors,Warnings,Info,Findings\n/.test(csv) && csv.trim().split('\n').length === 3 }); })()

name: tasks: a rebuild task saves the picked files back in place
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); q('[data-pm="task.new:rebuild"]').click(); await sleep(200); q('[data-pm="task.addFiles"]').click(); await sleep(300); q('[data-pm="task.browseOut"]').click(); await sleep(300); const id = m.state.editing.sel; window.__back = {}; window.__out = {}; const box = q('[data-pm-toggle="tkSame"]'); if (box && !box.checked) { box.click(); await sleep(150); } m.actions.updateSettings({ tasks: m.tasks.tasks().map((x) => (x.id === id ? { ...x, output: { ...x.output, sameAsSource: true } } : x)) }, { quiet: true }); q('[data-pm="task.run"]').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 300 && !m.tasks.task(id)?.lastRun; i++) await sleep(200); const tk = m.tasks.task(id); const back = Object.keys(window.__back).sort(); const ok = back.every((n) => JSON.parse(window.__back[n]).format === 'mymechanics'); return JSON.stringify({ status: tk.lastStatus, back, ok, log: tk.log.at(-1).lines.some((l) => /rebuilt|다시 만들었습니다/.test(l.text)) }); })()

name: tasks: a drawings task on the open document makes a drawing for every part without one
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const before = m.project.drawings.length; const need = m.project.parts.filter((p) => !m.project.drawings.some((d) => d.source?.id === p.id)).length; q('[data-pm="task.new:drawings"]').click(); await sleep(200); q('[data-pm-set="tkSrc"][data-value="current"]').click(); await sleep(150); q('[data-pm-set="tkStd"][data-value="ANSI"]').click(); await sleep(150); const id = m.state.editing.sel; q('[data-pm="task.run"]').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !m.tasks.task(id)?.lastRun; i++) await sleep(100); await sleep(200); const made = m.project.drawings.slice(before); return JSON.stringify({ need: need > 0, made: made.length === need, ansi: made.every((d) => d.format?.standard === 'ANSI' && d.projection === 'third' && d.sheet === 'Tabloid') }); })()

name: tasks: schedules — a weekly task shows its next run; a one-off task in the past runs on the next tick and turns itself off
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const id = m.state.editing.sel; q('[data-pm-set="tkSched"][data-value="weekly"]').click(); await sleep(200); const weekly = /Next run|다음 실행/.test(q('.left-pm-body').textContent) && Boolean(q('[data-pm-toggle="tkDay:1"]')); const t0 = m.tasks.task(id).lastRun; m.actions.updateSettings({ tasks: m.tasks.tasks().map((x) => (x.id === id ? { ...x, schedule: { ...x.schedule, mode: 'once', at: '2020-01-01T00:00' }, lastRun: null, enabled: true } : x)) }, { quiet: true }); m.tasks.tick(); for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !m.tasks.task(id)?.lastRun; i++) await sleep(100); await sleep(200); const tk = m.tasks.task(id); return JSON.stringify({ weekly, ran: Boolean(tk.lastRun) && tk.lastRun !== t0, off: tk.enabled === false, scheduled: tk.log.at(-1).lines[0].text.includes('schedule') || tk.log.at(-1).lines[0].text.includes('예약') }); })()

name: tasks: the log exports as CSV; a task is duplicated and deleted; the scheduler closes
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); let saved = null; window.showSaveFilePicker = async (o) => ({ name: o?.suggestedName ?? 'x', createWritable: async () => ({ write: async (b) => { saved = typeof b === 'string' ? b : await b.text(); }, close: async () => {} }) }); q('[data-pm="task.logCsv"]').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 30 && !saved; i++) await sleep(100); const n0 = m.tasks.tasks().length; q('[data-pm="task.dup"]').click(); await sleep(200); const n1 = m.tasks.tasks().length; q('[data-pm="task.del"]').click(); await sleep(200); const n2 = m.tasks.tasks().length; m.run('taskScheduler'); await sleep(200); m.actions.updateSettings({ tasks: [] }, { quiet: true }); return JSON.stringify({ csv: /^Time,Level,File,Message\n/.test(saved ?? ''), dup: n1 === n0 + 1, del: n2 === n0, mode: m.state.editing?.mode ?? null }); })()
